values: 一个不怎么靠谱的战士，普通攻击有小概率造成高额伤害。
An unreliable Hamster Warrior that has a small chance in dealing high damage with normal attacks.
The acorn knight is ready for battle!
满满！想到一个！超棒的点子！
Awesome! Uh, I mean- Chippy is grateful.
For the glory of all knights!
Aww... I'll catch up to you someday!
看我的橡果剑法，吓死我了。
Hah! Taste Chippy's blade! Wahh?! We're being ambushed! Oh- it's just you. Don't scare me like that.
大家都去哪儿了，嗨，我在这里！
Where did everyone go? Hey, Chippy's over here!
哇，这是满满最喜欢的东西！主人最了解满满了！
Wow! The Magister really knows Chippy's favorite things!
只要是主人送的，满满都喜欢！
If it comes from the Magister, Chippy is sure to love it!
Our adventure has been awesome lately!
Chippy wants lots and lots of sunflower seeds!
梅林不止一次吩咐跟随在侧的满满不需要太过拘束，但是满满依旧坚持着主人与骑士之间的礼仪，而不像漫漫那样直呼梅林其名。
Merlin has reassured Chippy to take it easy, but he insists on maintaining the formalities between a knight and his superior, refusing to address Merlin by name only.
满满曾向卢修斯讨教该如何成为一名出色的骑士。几小时后，卢修斯不得不紧急将他送至医师身旁——满满试图驯服一匹烈性野马，并光荣负伤。

Chippy once asked Lucius for advice on how to become an exceptional knight. A few hours later, Lucius had to rush him to a physician when Chippy got injured while trying to tame a ferocious wild horse.
作为使魔的满满刚刚被召唤不久，曾偶然在街边看到耀光骑士团凯旋而归，人民在为他们欢呼呐喊。那个瞬间，他第一次有了想要成为骑士的念头。
When Chippy was first summoned as a familiar, he saw the Lightbearer Heroic Order by chance on their triumphant return. Among the cheering crowd, he wished to become a knight for the very first time.
满满有个不愿被外人知晓的称号：幸运鼠。因为他在密集的箭雨中往返送信数次，却都没被射中。仓鼠骑士拒绝承认这是运气所致，而将成果归功于——实力！
Chippy has a nickname that he'd rather no one knows: Lucky. This is because he delivered messages multiple times in a dense rain of arrows without getting hit.
“那只毛茸茸的小东西？虽然不太聪明，却意外地很有忠勇。有他陪伴着梅林，我也能稍稍安心了。”——灰烬魔女米瑞尔
"That fluffy little creature? Well, he's not the brightest, but he's loyal and brave. I'm glad Merlin has him as a familiar." —The Scarlet Sorceress, Mirael
满满曾仔细地研究过霍根的步态，因为他也想拥有“领袖走路的英武感觉”。
Chippy once thoroughly studied the way Hogan walked because he wanted to "walk like a heroic leader."
许下成为骑士的愿望后，满满开始使用人类的剑与盾练习，每次都被过沉的铁盾压倒在地。解救满满数次后，梅林委托矮人工匠给他打造了现在的小型武器。
Chippy used to practice with human weapons, but the heavy metal shield kept crushing him until Merlin finally ordered him mini weapons from a dwarven craftsman.
漫漫曾有一整天没见到满满，后来才发现因为别人的几句夸奖，满满替抱病的守城卫兵巡逻了一整天。
Once, Hammie couldn't find Chippy for a whole day. She later found out that Chippy patrolled the entire day for a sick guard because he once praised him as an excellent knight.
满满的思维就像手中的短剑一样笔直且难以弯折，他往往会根据自己的第一印象，迅速将遇到的人分为两类——好人，或坏人。

Chippy's thoughts are as straight as an arrow. He quickly labels the people he meets as good or bad based on his first impression. "When I first met Valen, I knew he was a good guy. He just likes to talk a lot."
满满借过许多英雄冒险史诗，但因为他认得的字实在有限，大部分书最后都是漫漫念给他听的。

Chippy borrowed many heroic adventure books. However, he doesn't know many words. In the end, Hammie has to read these books to him. "Hammie is annoying sometimes, but she's usually very nice... Usually..."
说起来，最开始见到阿尔萨时，我吓了一跳呢！就看到一个球形从远方向我们滚来……
Honestly, when I first laid eyes on Alsa rolling towards us from a distance, I was scared...
漫漫 & 满满 & 阿尔萨 & 索恩
How's the meat coming along? Is it ready yet?
满满 & 索恩 & 阿尔萨
说到吃的话，沙漠里的旅人树果还不错……噜噜呢？有爱吃的食物吗？
Speaking of food, the wanderfruit growing in the desert is quite tasty... Lumont, what do you like to eat?
满满 & 噜噜 & 漫漫
远处武斗场的呼声又传来了，你们听到了吗？
More cheering from the arena! Do you hear that?
阿尔萨 & 满满 & 曼卡拉
赏金猎人这行，有个笑话。
There's a popular joke among bounty hunters.
瓦尔克 & 满满 & 索恩
主人，如果有一天满满和你分开了，你会不会想满满？
Magister, if Chippy left you one day, would you miss Chippy?
等一下，你不能拿走我的水壶，那里面可是我从集市淘换来的好水，一点沙子都没掺。
Wait! Don't take my bottle. I got this delicious water from the market. It doesn't have a single grain of sand.
阿德 & 满满 & 瓦尔克 & 萨忒娜
安丹德拉为什么在休息时经常闭上眼睛？好像也没在睡觉……
Antandra, why do you like to close your eyes when we rest? Chippy doesn't think you're sleeping...
嘿，仓鼠小骑士，你还好吧？怎么一脸马上要昏过去的样子？
Hey, little hamster knight, are you alright? Why do you look like you're about to pass out?
满满 & 漫漫 & 辛巴达
有句话怎么说的来着？“欲言又止时，就像吞了只蜥蜴，却留了截蜥蜴尾巴在嘴边……”
What's that saying? "Holding back your words is like swallowing a lizard but leaving its tail hanging out of your mouth..."
辛巴达 & 满满 & 漫漫
魔法师大人，为什么盯着我的铁头瞧？
Master Mage, why are you so fixated on my Hardhead?
呼金 & 漫漫 & 满满
除了你，村子里应该还有和你年龄相仿的年轻人吧？
Apart from you, there must be other young people around, yes?
Wow, this smoked fish is delicious!
小水村的遭遇真是令人难过。我们能不能帮忙做点什么呢？
The situation in Brineville is really heartbreaking. Is there anything we can do to help?
主人，漫漫，你们有看到吗？
魔法能让人死而复生吗？
Can magic bring people back to life?
索尼娅 & 满满 & 漫漫
看不出来呀，你们这两个小家伙，居然能经历那么多冒险。
I wouldn't have guessed. You two little ones have had so many adventures.
满满捡到了很多漂亮的羽毛！
Chippy found a lot of beautiful feathers!
满满 & 索尼娅 & 漫漫
说实话，我也不是没出过海，但这次的冒险也太不一样了！
I've been out to sea before, but this time just hits differently!
辛巴达 & 漫漫 & 满满
嘻嘻，才不给你呢，这是给索尼娅姐姐的！
Haha, I'm not giving it to you! It's for Sonja!
奈拉 & 满满 & 索尼娅 & 漫漫
我小时候当过乞丐、小偷、扒手。甚至为了一口面包，和野狗打架。
When I was young, I was a beggar, a thief, and a pickpocket. I even fought stray dogs for scraps of bread.
索尼娅 & 漫漫 & 满满
索尼娅，满满在废墟里找到了这个！好像是血薇帮的标志！
Sonja, Chippy found this in the ruins! This seems to be the logo of Carmine Whispers!
Ugh! This... This makes me sick!
满满被扣在旅馆里的时候，听到了一些锈锚港本地流传的鬼故事。
Chippy heard some supernatural stories circulating in Rustport while I was locked up at the inn.
满满，你从哪里又买了一把剑？
Chippy, where did you get that sword from?
你们知道，之前的绿水村是什么样的吗？
Do you know what Greenbrook used to be like?
索尼娅 & 漫漫 & 满满
漫漫，你能不能帮我研制一些可以驱逐亡灵的魔法药水？我想涂在剑上！
Hammie, could you make some Graveborn-repellant magic potion for me? I want to apply it to my sword!
唔——唔哇啊啊！不管是什么，快出来！满满才不怕你！！
Ah!!! Woah!!! I don't care what you are, just show yourself right now! Chippy isn't afraid of you!
要是我的朋友们知道我遇到了魔法师，还做出了附魔的东西，不知道会有多羡慕我嚯嚯！
My buddies would be green with envy if they knew I met a mage and managed to make enchanted stuff!
嚯，我说梅林，你有没有什么魔法能让这里的温度再降低一些？
Merlin, do you know any spells that could lower the temperature here even further?
法拉莫尔先生，祭典结束以后，你会一直留在雪松镇吗？
Mr. Faramor, will you be staying in Cedartown after the festival is over?
漫漫 & 法拉莫尔 & 满满
完了，又失败了！已经是第十四次了！
Rats, I've failed again! That's the fourteenth time already!
冬日祭典好棒啊！我还是第一次堆这么大的雪人！
This festival is so fun! I've never built such a huge snowman before!
格尔达女士，这次的“鬼影密室”是你设计的吗？
Madam Gerda, is the Ghostly Getaway your brainchild?
满满 & 格尔达 & 漫漫
洛桑，你怎么会跑到这里来打工呢？
Lorsan, how did you end up working here?
漫漫 & 洛桑 & 满满
洛桑，满满很好奇，你变成雪人的时候有什么感受？
Lorsan, Chippy's curious—what was it like being a snowman?
满满 & 洛桑 & 漫漫
瓦丽卡？你刚才在温泉里泡了好久，我和梅林有点担心，温泉泡太久很容易头晕的。
Valka, is that you? You were in there so long that we got a bit worried. Soaking too long can make you dizzy.
漫漫 & 瓦丽卡 & 满满
这种雕刻纹样我肯定在哪本书上看到过……
I must have seen this pattern in a book before...
休息……锻炼……休息……锻炼……休息……锻炼！
Rest... Train... Rest... Train... Rest... Train!
听杨凯维奇修士说，白山修道院的修士和修女早晨四点半就要起床！
Callahan told us the acolytes at the Whiteridge Temple have to get up at four-thirty in the morning every day!
满满，你为什么用这么奇怪的眼神看着我的武器？
Chippy, why are you staring at my weapon like that?
白山好冷啊！风就像刀子一样，吹得我的脸又冷又痛。
It's freezing in Whiteridge! My cheeks are numb and sting from the wind.
看好了，先用劈砍或者刺击敌人逼对方闪躲，然后让过剑锋，反转长剑，近身用剑柄攻击手腕……像这样！
Remember to start with slashes and thrusts, forcing your opponent to dodge. Then, reverse your sword and aim at your opponent's wrist with the hilt... like this!
嘿，你们！不要挡住我的墓碑！
矮人的酒太烈了！闻着头晕晕的……
It has such a strong flavor...
漫漫 & 满满 & 霍根
主人，满满觉得这里的矮人对魔法师的态度好奇怪！
Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
巨矿祭，锤击节，锻炉庆典，酒桶狂欢日……
Ore Festival, Hammer Day, Furnace Celebration, Barrel Bonanza...
<style="stress"><player_name></style>，你是怎么认识呼金这小子的？
<style="stress"><player_name></style>, how did you get to know Hugin?
主人，满满从湖边带了好吃的回来！
主人，满满没想到，深岩村竟然在这么高的地方！进出都得坐升降机！
Magister, Chippy didn't know Brimstone Village was so high up! We actually need to take a lift to get there!
哇！主人，你终于公开身份啦！
Woah! Magister! You finally revealed your true identity!
满满，你手里拿的是什么？
咕噜噜……好凉好甜！这杯魔法冰饮里有好多小气泡，喝下去咕嘟咕嘟在肚子里炸开，好像在放小烟花！
Glug glug... Aaah! This magic icy drink is bursting with fizzy bubbles! It's like tiny fireworks are popping in Chippy's stomach!
你好，我的老朋友！不介意我加入你们的休息中吧。
Ah, my old friend! I hope you don't mind me joining your little get-together here.
唔……肚子饿了。漫漫，你那里有什么好吃的？
Ugh... So hungry. Hammie, do you have anything to eat?
满满 & 漫漫 & 维伦
真想找时间去喝上一杯。
Chippy wants lots and lots of sunflower seeds!
哈哈哈，好久不见了！隆冬节快乐！
Hoho, it's been ages! Happy Winter Carnival, my friend!
卡夫拉 & 满满 & 漫漫
科林大叔，你的手臂是怎么变成现在这样的？满满从来没见过这么严重的伤！
Uncle Korin, what happened to your arms? These wounds look pretty severe!
薄暮丛林好神奇呀，能在让人不知不觉间获得平静。
The Dark Forest is truly magical. It feels like the forest is quietly bestowing tranquility upon us.
满满一直很好奇一件事。
Chippy has been curious about something for a long time.
好孩子，真没想到，你们在薄暮丛林外帮了洛桑那么多。
You two have been quite the help to Lorsan outside the Dark Forest.
薄暮丛林里能找到的美食真多啊！
There are so many tasty treats in the Dark Forest!
布莱恩的艾洛娜很漂亮哇，她的眼睛像宝石一样单良，羽毛也很润顺！
Bryon's companion, Elona, is so beautiful. Her eyes are as clear as diamonds. Her feathers are as smooth as silk.
漫漫 & 满满 & 布莱恩
来丛林后，满满一直在努力注意言辞……
Ever since coming to the forest, Chippy has been paying special attention not to say too much...
我曾听过一句话，“星空中藏着每个人的命运”。
I once heard a saying, "Everyone's destiny is hidden in the stars."
雅顿贤者，你怎么知道跟着蝴蝶就能找到月影乡呢？
Master Arden, how did you know that following the butterflies would lead to Ivoryshade?
这是纸鸢尾，这是绿黛兰……喏，漫漫你来闻闻，很香的。
This is an iris, and this is a green orchid... Here, Hammie, come. These smell very nice.
莱卡 & 漫漫 & 满满
雅顿贤者，占卜的原理到底是什么呀？
Master Arden, what exactly is divination?
唔唔，我脸上的毛毛是不是有点脏了呀……
Hmm, is there a bit of dirt on my face?
漫漫 & 满满 & 卢修斯 & 维伦
特弥希娅的“晨曦“真是帅气啊……又高大，又强壮……
Temesia's horse, Dawn, is so cool. It's so tall and strong...
阿塔兰忒小姐为什么要在腰上挂一支鞭子呢？
Why does Atalanta carry a whip at her waist?
一、二、三！怎么样，这些够了吗？
One, two, three! How about this? Is that enough?
卢修斯 & 漫漫 & 满满
啊，糟糕，箭囊上的毛皮好像被打湿了……
Oh, no, the fur on my quiver seems to have gotten wet...
